entries.multiplayer.invite.received: Invitation {code} received. Connect and choose JOIN ROOM when you are ready.
entries.multiplayer.level.mismatch: Your profile is at level {current}. This room is still at level {room}; leave it and create a race at your current level.
entries.multiplayer.validation.code: Room codes have 6 characters. Check the code you received.
entries.multiplayer.validation.create: Choose an unlocked route and name your room before continuing.
entries.multiplayer.validation.route: This route is not ready yet.
entries.multiplayer.level.guest: Guest sessions can only race at level 1. Leave this room, then create or join a level 1 room.
entries.multiplayer.content.incomplete: The race content has not finished loading.
entries.multiplayer.message.saving: The server is confirming your saved points and rewards. Please stay connected.
entries.multiplayer.message.reconnecting: Your place is held while you reconnect. Return to the menu to end this session.
entries.multiplayer.message.results: The room's official results. Return to the lobby together to start another race.
entries.multiplayer.message.browser: Create your own race or enter a code to ride with friends.
entries.multiplayer.message.room: The room code is below. Invite friends, get ready and wait for the host to start.
entries.multiplayer.hint.countdown: All riders are ready. Hold steady; the race is about to begin.
entries.multiplayer.hint.not-ready: You are not ready. Press READY to join the start.
entries.multiplayer.hint.waiting: Ready. Waiting for the other riders.
entries.multiplayer.hint.host: Everyone is ready. You can start the race.
entries.multiplayer.hint.members: Everyone is ready. Waiting for the host to start.
entries.multiplayer.result.receiving: Receiving official results from the server…
entries.multiplayer.result.saved: RESULTS SAVED · Guest rewards apply only to this session.
entries.multiplayer.result.pending: AWAITING SAVE CONFIRMATION · Profile rewards are not confirmed yet.
entries.multiplayer.error.room-full: This room is full. Choose another room or create a new one.
entries.multiplayer.error.room-not-found: Room not found. Check the code or refresh the list.
entries.multiplayer.error.room-started: The race has started. You can join once the room returns to the lobby.
entries.multiplayer.error.host-only: Only the host can do this.
entries.multiplayer.error.not-ready: All riders must be connected and ready before the race can start.
entries.multiplayer.error.invalid-name: Names must contain 1 to 24 characters and no control characters.
entries.multiplayer.error.room-settings: Check the room name and number of bots.
entries.multiplayer.error.course-unavailable: This route is still in development. Choose Canyon Run.
entries.multiplayer.error.campaign-locked: This level is locked for your profile. Choose an unlocked level in your career.
entries.multiplayer.error.repair-required: Your bike is wrecked. Leave the room and repair it in the garage before racing.
entries.multiplayer.error.profile-busy: Your profile has a race that has not finished saving. Wait for the results, then try again.
entries.multiplayer.error.profile-revoked: Your profile session has expired or been revoked. Open your account to sign in again.
entries.multiplayer.error.already-in-room: You are already in a room. Leave that room first.
entries.multiplayer.error.profile-in-room: This profile is holding a place in another session. Choose New Guest to add a separate player.
entries.multiplayer.error.profile-unavailable: The server could not read your profile yet. Try again later or choose New Guest.
entries.multiplayer.error.resume-expired: Your reserved place has expired. Reconnect and join a new room.
entries.multiplayer.error.resume-owner: This session has been opened elsewhere. Choose New Guest to play separately.
entries.multiplayer.error.version-mismatch: The game and server versions differ. Reload the page or update your LAN package.
entries.multiplayer.error.server-full: The server is full. Please try again later.
entries.multiplayer.error.room-capacity: The server has reached its room limit. Join a room with space available.
entries.multiplayer.error.persistence-pending: The server is preparing. Please wait a moment.
entries.multiplayer.error.persistence-queue-full: The server is busy saving data. Please try again later.
entries.multiplayer.error.result-save-retry: The server is retrying the result save. Keep this session open to receive confirmation.
entries.multiplayer.error.start-cancelled: The countdown was cancelled because the members or host changed.
entries.multiplayer.error.result-required: The race has not ended yet. Please wait for the official results.
entries.multiplayer.error.command-rate: You are acting too quickly. Wait a moment, then try again.
entries.multiplayer.error.not-room-member: You are no longer in this room. Refresh the list and join again.
entries.multiplayer.error.unknown: This request could not be completed. Try again or reconnect to the server.
entries.multiplayer.heading.eyebrow: RACING BOIS / HIT THE ROAD TOGETHER
entries.multiplayer.browser.empty-rooms: No rooms yet. Create one and send the code to your friends.
entries.multiplayer.invite.link-hint: Select and copy this link to invite friends.
